name: tamga
description: Type-safe nominal branding utilities for TypeScript.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:lib && pnpm run build:dts
scripts.check: pnpm run check:type && pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:format
scripts.check:format: oxfmt --check .oxfmtrc.json package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json tsdown.config.ts vitest.config.ts README.md SPEC.md src
scripts.format: oxfmt --write .oxfmtrc.json package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json tsdown.config.ts vitest.config.ts README.md SPEC.md src
